definitions.name: U1A.BREDUCE
definitions.body: '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE
definitions.note: bracket String (up to 12 chars) -> what remains after repeatedly deleting adjacent () and [] pairs

definitions.name: U1A.BSTEPS
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'BC' BIND 1 -1 BC '(' EQ NOT BC '[' EQ NOT AND NOT SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket String -> Vector of +1 per opening and -1 per closing bracket

definitions.name: U1A.ARGMAX
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> index of its largest element, first on ties

definitions.name: U1A.MASKED
definitions.body: 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: values mask -> the values whose mask lane is TRUE, in order

definitions.name: U1A.LEDGER
definitions.body: ZIP 'LZ' BIND LZ 0 GET LZ 1 GET G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: Vector of [ key amount ] pairs -> Record key to summed amount, first-appearance order

definitions.name: U1A.UNWORDS
definitions.note: Vector of space-free Strings -> one String joined by single spaces

definitions.name: U1A.CAP
definitions.body: 'CW' BIND CW CHARS 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER CW CHARS 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty word -> first letter upper case, rest lower case

definitions.name: U1A.MODEFIRST
definitions.body: TALLY 'MT' BIND MT KEYS MT VALUES U1A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: Vector -> its most frequent element, the first-appearing one on ties

definitions.name: U1A.RSTARTS
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND 0 RV LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE [ 'RI' BIND RI 0 EQ NOT RV RI GET RV RI 1 SUB GET EQ AND NOT ] MAP
definitions.note: non-empty Vector -> truth per position: TRUE where a run of equal adjacent values starts

definitions.name: U1A.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS MS LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MS LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of numbers -> median (mean of the two middles when even)

solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: 'BS' BIND 0 BS CHARS LENGTH RANGE [ 'BK' BIND BS CHARS BK TAKE JOIN U1A.BREDUCE '' EQ ] FILTER 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.ledger.top_name: U1A.LEDGER 'LR' BIND LR KEYS LR VALUES U1A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.ledger.debtors: U1A.LEDGER 'LD' BIND LD KEYS LD VALUES 0 LT U1A.MASKED
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'LE' BIND LE LE [ 1 GET ] MAP U1A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ U1A.CAP ] MAP U1A.UNWORDS
solutions.prose.longest: G0A.WORDS 'PW' BIND PW PW [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP U1A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.runs.rle: 'RW' BIND 0 RW LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE RW U1A.RSTARTS U1A.MASKED 'RS' BIND RW RS GET RS 1 DROP RW LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT RS SUB 2 COLLECT ZIP
solutions.runs.upruns: 'UV' BIND 0 UV LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE [ 'UI' BIND UI 0 EQ NOT UV UI GET UV UI 1 SUB GET GT AND ] MAP 0 [ 'UF' BIND 'UA' BIND UA 1 ADD 1 UF SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.runs.majority: 'MJ' BIND MJ TALLY 'MJT' BIND MJT VALUES U1A.ARGMAX 'MJI' BIND MJT KEYS MJI GET NIL MJT VALUES MJI GET 2 MUL MJ LENGTH GT SELECT
solutions.sensor.filled: 'SV' BIND SV SV [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ 'SX' BIND 'SA' BIND SX SA SX NIL? NOT SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: [ NIL? ] MAP 'GM' BIND GM [ FALSE ] GM -1 DROP CONCAT NOT AND [ TRUE EQ ] FILTER LENGTH
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: [ NIL? ] MAP 0 [ 'GF' BIND 'GA' BIND GA 1 ADD 0 GF SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'RT' BIND 0 RT LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE 1 DROP [ 'RJ' BIND RT RJ GET 'RA' BIND RT RJ 1 SUB GET 'RB' BIND 1 RA RA NIL? SELECT 1 RB RB NIL? SELECT DIV NIL RA NIL? NOT RB NIL? NOT AND SELECT ] MAP
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'SV' BIND SV [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 'SP' BIND SP SP 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD 'SM' BIND SV [ 'SC' BIND 1 SC SC NIL? SELECT SM DIV NIL SC NIL? NOT SELECT ] MAP
solutions.series.mad: 'MD' BIND MD MD U1A.MEDIAN SUB 'MDV' BIND MDV MDV -1 MUL MAX U1A.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'M3' BIND M3 -2 DROP M3 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD M3 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'RM' BIND RM RM 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
